This enabled them to link my previous record and ailments and give me the comfort of knowing the GP is actually interested in me as their patient if they have looked at my record beforehand or bothered to review it albeit briefly. .  Despite never seeing the same GP twice at the Practice,  they have always made themselves aware of my recent medical problems asking other questions during the appointment linked to my medical history over the last year.  It seems now we must request an appointment with a GP specifically otherwise, it turns out to be with a Nurse Practitioner which does not fill me with any confidence as pleasant as she was that my econsult was even reviewed by a doctor.
